items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] See, I got John Handy on alto. ... [INTERVIEWEE] never done him nothing, but he should play more vampy.

ctx.x: He doesn't move a thing, you know? Not the muscle.
Just like the statue of Handy in Memphis, you know? Yeah. Like this. Oh, boy.
He can really play that, man.
